correctness.rationale: For any generic pair of rank-two Plücker configurations, separate GL2 row changes normalize its first three x_i and y_i to (0,1,2), simultaneous column scaling fixes first input factors, and global scaling fixes λ1=1. The invariant target ratios u2,u3, uj,vj,wj recover every normalized coordinate: xj=2(wj−vj)/(1−2vj+wj), Bj=(1−vj)xj+vj, yj=xj/Bj, λj=uj Bj, λ2=u2, λ3=u3. Direct substitution yields the identity on an explicit nonempty dense open; the intrinsic ratios give a rational inverse and transcendence basis of size 3n−7. Because all generic pairs admit this normalization, fiber equality means they differ by the simultaneous free diagonal torus; no extra generic components. Independent exact rational substitutions of 24 nondegenerate parameter sets for n=5,6,8 corroborated inverse and projective coordinate normalization. The statement is only generic over C, with denominators required nonzero.
